mission_03: For the counter, use functional updates: setCount(prev => prev + 1) to ensure you always work with the latest state.
For arrays in state, create new arrays: setTodos([...todos, newTodo]) for add, setTodos(todos.filter(...)) for delete.
For form objects, spread the previous state: setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value })) to update a single field.
